resources.string: Chennai – Capital of Tamil Nadu. Renowned for Marina Beach, Kapaleeshwarar Temple, and rich South Indian art & culture.
Bengaluru – Silicon Valley of India. Famous for IT hubs, Lalbagh Botanical Garden, Cubbon Park, and pleasant climate.
Mumbai – Financial capital of India. Home to the iconic Gateway of India, Marine Drive, and Bollywood film industry.
Delhi – Capital territory of India. Historic metropolis with India Gate, Red Fort, Qutub Minar, and bustling bazaars.
Hyderabad – City of Pearls. World-famous for Charminar, Golconda Fort, Ramoji Film City, and royal Biryani cuisine.
